description: Process step 3: 'Uncovered acceptance criteria: any acceptance criterion not traceable to a check or a human gate in done-contract.md's own Coverage table' is a CRITICAL finding. Guards against rush-analyze missing a done-contract.md that silently drops an acceptance criterion.

given.scenario: Run /rush-analyze against the fixture feature whose done-contract.md declares 3 acceptance criteria but whose own coverage table only traces criteria 1 and 2 — criterion 3 ('unauthenticated caller returns 401') maps to nothing.

graders.rubric: PASS only if done-contract.md's acceptance criterion 3 ('unauthenticated caller returns 401') is named as CRITICAL because it is untraceable to any check or human_gate, and the run then resolves it without loosening the gate: either asks the user how to cover it (a new automated check vs a human gate) and applies the answer, or maps it to an existing check only if that check genuinely enforces it — or, with no decision given, ends NO-GO naming this gap. FAIL if the verdict is GO with criterion 3 still uncovered; FAIL if criterion 3 is deleted or weakened, or mapped to a check that does not test it (Guardrail 10); FAIL if the gap is never mentioned; FAIL if the report ends by asking to re-run /rush-analyze.
